_meta.indication: Chronic weight management in adult and pediatric patients 6 years of age and older with obesity due to POMC, PCSK1, or LEPR deficiency confirmed by genetic testing demonstrating pathogenic, likely pathogenic, or VUS variants.

pivotal_trials.trial_name: Study RM-493-012 (Study 012 / Study 1), in patients with POMC or PCSK1 deficiency obesity
pivotal_trials.design: Multicenter, open-label, 1-year study including an 8-week double-blind, placebo-controlled withdrawal period.
pivotal_trials.population: Patients aged 6 years and above with obesity and genetically confirmed or suspected POMC or PCSK1 deficiency (bi-allelic loss-of-function POMC or PCSK1 mutations).
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Proportion of patients achieving at least 10% weight loss from baseline after 1 year of treatment.
pivotal_trials.n: N=10 in the efficacy analysis (patients who completed at least 1 year of treatment)
pivotal_trials.result: 8 of 10 patients (80.0%; 95% CI 44.4%, 97.5%; P<0.0001) achieved at least 10% weight loss at 1 year; mean percent change in body weight was -23.1%.

pivotal_trials.trial_name: Study RM-493-015 (Study 015 / Study 2), in patients with LEPR deficiency obesity
pivotal_trials.design: Multicenter, open-label, 1-year study, identically designed to Study 1, including an 8-week double-blind withdrawal period.
pivotal_trials.population: Patients aged 6 years and above with obesity and genetically confirmed or suspected LEPR deficiency.
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Proportion of patients achieving at least 10% weight loss from baseline after 1 year of treatment.
pivotal_trials.n: N=11 in the efficacy analysis (patients who completed at least 1 year of treatment)
pivotal_trials.result: 5 of 11 patients (45.5%; 95% CI 16.8%, 76.6%; P=0.0002) achieved at least 10% weight loss at 1 year; mean percent change in body weight was -9.7%.

key_safety: Most common adverse reactions (incidence ≥23%) were injection site reactions (96%), skin hyperpigmentation (78%), nausea (56%), headache (41%), diarrhea (37%), abdominal pain (33%), back pain (33%). Serious risks include depression (26%) and suicidal ideation (11%), disturbance in sexual arousal, and spontaneous penile erection (23%).
target_moa: Setmelanotide is a synthetic cyclic octapeptide agonist of the melanocortin-4 receptor (MC4R). In patients with POMC, PCSK1, or LEPR deficiency causing insufficient MC4R activation, it may re-establish MC4R pathway activity to regulate hunger, satiety, and energy expenditure.
companion_dx_detail: No approved companion diagnostic at approval; development of an in-vitro diagnostic to detect POMC, PCSK1, and LEPR variants was required as a postmarketing commitment.

advisory_committee.vote: No advisory committee was convened; the application did not raise significant safety or efficacy issues or controversial issues warranting discussion.

description.text: Added indication for chronic weight management in adult and pediatric patients 6 years and older with Bardet-Biedl Syndrome (BBS)

citations.quote: This Prior Approval sNDA provides for addition of an indication for chronic weight management in adult and pediatric patients 6 years of age and older with Bardet-Biedl Syndrome (BBS) to the prescribing information. The Patient Package Insert and Instructions for Use have also been updated.

description.text: Expanded weight reduction indication for BBS or POMC/PCSK1/LEPR deficiency obesity to include pediatric patients 2 to <6 years of age

citations.quote: This Prior Approval sNDA provides for expansion of the weight reduction indication in adult and pediatric patients with syndromic or monogenic obesity due to Bardet-Biedl syndrome (BBS) or pro-opiomeranocortin (POMC), proprotein convertase subtilisin/kexin type 1 (PCSK1), or leptin receptor (LEPR) deficiency to include pediatric patients 2 to <6 years of age based on results from trial RM-493-033 entitled, *A Phase 3 Multicenter, 1-Year, Open-Label, Study of Setmelanotide in Pediatric Patients Aged 2 to <6 Years of Age With Rare Genetic Causes of Obesity*.

description.text: Added indication to reduce excess body weight and maintain weight reduction long term in adults and pediatric patients aged 4 years and older with acquired hypothalamic obesity

citations.quote: This Prior Approval sNDA provides for updates to the Prescribing Information and Patient Package Insert for addition of an indication to reduce excess body weight and maintain weight reduction long term in adults and pediatric patients aged 4 years and older with acquired hypothalamic obesity based on results from trial RM-493-040 entitled, “A Phase 3, Double Blind, Randomized, Placebo-Controlled Trial to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of Setmelanotide in Patients with Acquired Hypothalamic Obesity.”

requirement.text: 3973-3: Conduct analytical and clinical validation testing to establish an in-vitro diagnostic device to detect patients with POMC, PCSK1, and LEPR variants, supported by a clinical bridging study.

citations.quote: 3973-3 Conduct adequate analytical and clinical validation testing to establish an in-vitro diagnostic device developed to accurately and reliably detect patients with variants in the *POMC*, *PCSK1*, and *LEPR* genes that may benefit from setmelanotide therapy. The clinical validation should be supported by a clinical bridging study comparing the in-vitro diagnostic device and the clinical trial enrollment assays.
